projectDescription: A decentralized P2P escrow protocol on Base blockchain enabling trustless USDC trading against local fiat currencies across LATAM and emerging markets, with payment infrastructure for merchants and developers.
keyFeatures: Decentralized P2P USDC escrow marketplace with 18+ fiat currencies
Smart contract-backed trustless escrow with dispute resolution
Payment Links API for programmatic USDC checkout on Base
Webhook notifications for real-time payment confirmations
Multi-chain deposits (auto-convert to USDC on Base)
Merchant collateral system with 2x order capacity
Public and private order types with configurable payment methods
Gold user tier with zero protocol fees
Gasless transactions (protocol sponsors gas via paymaster)
publicApiSurface: POST /api/payment-links — create a USDC payment link
DELETE /api/payment-links/:id — cancel a pending payment link
POST /api/payment-links/widget — create payment link via widget
achylo:success / achylo:error / achylo:cancel / achylo:ready JavaScript events
